ns2:course.label: International Cooperation
ns2:course.description: A study of cooperation among states. Cooperation dilemmas and their solutions, with focus on institutional arrangements that are aimed to facilitate cooperation among states. Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 281, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 281, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
